Incumbent Democrat [[Bob Miller (Nevada governor)|Bob Miller]] won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee [[Jim Gibbons (American politician)|Jim Gibbons]] (who would later go on to narrowly win the governorship in [[2006 Nevada gubernatorial election|2006]]). This was the last time a Democrat was elected Governor of Nevada until [[Steve Sisolak]]'s victory in [[2018 Nevada gubernatorial election|2018]], the last time a Democratic candidate has received over 50% of the vote, and the last time a Democratic governor in Nevada has won re-election. As of 2025, this is also the last time that a gubernatorial nominee and a lieutenant gubernatorial nominee of different political parties were elected in Nevada respectively. This was the first Nevada gubernatorial election since [[1962 Nevada gubernatorial election|1962]] in which the winner was of the same party as the incumbent president. == Democratic primary == === Candidate === *[[Bob Miller (Nevada governor)|Bob Miller]], incumbent [[Governor of Nevada]] *[[Jan Jones Blackhurst|Janis Lyle Laverty]], incumbent [[Mayor of Las Vegas]] *Rhinestone Cowboy *Samuel F.
